response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS o FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(st.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(st.avg_usage - overall.o) AS avg_above_average FROM st, overall WHERE st.avg_usage > overall.o
